title: In Order To
subtitle: in order to = 為了；以便；為的是
description: in order to = 為了；以便；為的是

words.note: 最簡潔、最自然的替代方式，日常和正式英語都非常常見。
words.example: She left early to avoid the traffic.

exercises.original: She left early in order to avoid the traffic.
exercises.zh: 她提早離開，以避開交通擠塞。

options.explanation: 最簡潔的目的不定式，直接接動詞原形 avoid。
表示原因，後面需要完整子句。
單獨放在這裡不能直接接動詞原形表示目的。
不能說 for avoid；for 後通常接名詞或 -ing。

exercises.original: The team met early in order to prepare for the presentation.
exercises.zh: 團隊提早見面，為的是準備簡報。

options.explanation: 主語 the team 執行 prepare，直接用目的不定式最自然。
會把「準備」變成原因，而不是目的。
後面需要完整子句，例如 so that they could prepare。
需配合不同結構，如 for preparing，但此處不自然。

exercises.original: He saved money in order to buy a new computer.
exercises.zh: 他儲錢是為了買一部新電腦。

options.explanation: save money 的目的就是 buy a new computer。
需要完整子句，如 so that he could buy...。
不能直接替代目的不定式。

words.note: 比 to 稍正式，常用來清楚標示行動目的。
words.example: The company reduced costs so as to remain competitive.

exercises.original: The company reduced costs in order to remain competitive.
exercises.zh: 公司削減成本，以保持競爭力。
exercises.upgrade: so as to · 為了；以便

options.explanation: 較正式地表達削減成本的目的，後接動詞原形 remain。
表示為可能情況作準備。
需要完整子句，如 so that it could remain competitive。

exercises.original: The instructions were rewritten in order to make them easier to understand.
exercises.zh: 說明被重新編寫，以令內容更容易理解。
exercises.upgrade: so as to · 為了；以便

options.explanation: 正式書面語中很自然地表達改寫的目的。

exercises.original: The road was widened in order to improve traffic flow.
exercises.zh: 道路被擴闊，以改善交通流量。
exercises.upgrade: so as to · 為了；以便

options.explanation: 清楚表示擴闊道路的目的。

words.note: 較正式，常見於政策、法律、行政和程序語境，後面通常接名詞或 -ing。
words.example: The data were collected for the purpose of evaluating the programme.

exercises.original: The data were collected in order to evaluate the programme.
exercises.zh: 收集這些數據是為了評估該計劃。
exercises.upgrade: for the purpose of evaluating · 為了評估

options.explanation: for the purpose of 後面自然接 -ing 形式。
語意變成原因，而且搭配生硬。
so as to 才是正確結構。
表示可能情況，不是目的。
標準結構通常是 for the purpose of + -ing/noun。

exercises.original: The room is used in order to conduct confidential interviews.
exercises.zh: 這個房間用於進行機密訪問。
exercises.upgrade: for the purpose of conducting · 為了進行

options.explanation: 正式地表示該房間的用途，結構正確。
缺少 to，而且應接動詞原形。
purposefully = 故意地，不等於「為了……」。

exercises.original: The samples were stored in order to support future testing.
exercises.zh: 樣本被保存，以供日後測試之用。
exercises.upgrade: for the purpose of supporting · 為了支援

options.explanation: 正式地說明保存樣本的用途。
so that 後需完整子句。
是「有目的的支援」，不是目的結構。

words.note: 強調一個清晰目標或預期結果，後面通常接名詞或 -ing。
words.example: The scheme was introduced with the aim of reducing youth unemployment.

exercises.original: The scheme was introduced in order to reduce youth unemployment.
exercises.zh: 推出這項計劃旨在減少青年失業。
exercises.upgrade: with the aim of reducing · 旨在減少

options.explanation: with the aim of 後面自然接 -ing，突出政策目標。
現代英語偶爾可見，但標準、最自然形式是 with the aim of + -ing。

exercises.original: The campaign was launched in order to increase recycling rates.
exercises.zh: 推出這項宣傳活動旨在提高回收率。
exercises.upgrade: with the aim of increasing · 旨在提高

options.explanation: campaign 有明確政策目標，這個正式表達很自然。
表示可能情況，不是目的。
缺少自然名詞結構，如 for an increase in...，而且語意不同。

exercises.original: The training was redesigned in order to improve staff performance.
exercises.zh: 培訓經重新設計，旨在改善員工表現。
exercises.upgrade: with the aim of improving · 旨在改善

options.explanation: redesigned 表示有清晰改善目標，搭配自然。

words.note: 表示某人或機構為達成目標而作出努力，通常暗示結果未必保證成功。
words.example: The hospital hired extra staff in an effort to shorten waiting times.

exercises.original: The hospital hired extra staff in order to shorten waiting times.
exercises.zh: 醫院增聘人手，希望縮短等候時間。
exercises.upgrade: in an effort to · 為了努力……；為求……

options.explanation: 增聘人手是為改善問題而採取的努力，但不保證一定成功。
需要完整子句，如 so that it could shorten...。

exercises.original: The company cut prices in order to attract more customers.
exercises.zh: 公司減價，希望吸引更多顧客。
exercises.upgrade: in an effort to · 為了努力……；為求……

options.explanation: 減價是主動採取的策略，目的是吸引顧客。
需要不同句法，如 made efforts to attract...。

exercises.original: The council planted more trees in order to reduce summer temperatures.
exercises.zh: 議會種植更多樹木，希望降低夏季氣溫。
exercises.upgrade: in an effort to · 為了努力……；為求……

options.explanation: 植樹是為達成降溫目標而採取的措施。
後面通常接名詞，且表示原因。

words.note: 較正式，表示現在採取行動，是為了日後達到某個目標。後面通常接名詞或 -ing。
words.example: The company reviewed its procedures with a view to improving safety.

exercises.original: The company reviewed its procedures in order to improve safety.
exercises.zh: 公司檢討程序，以改善安全水平。
exercises.upgrade: with a view to improving · 以改善為目的

options.explanation: 這裡的 to 是介詞，所以後面接 -ing，並表示着眼於未來改善。
常見錯誤；這個結構中的 to 是介詞，標準用法是 to improving。

exercises.original: The two sides reopened talks in order to reach a long-term agreement.
exercises.zh: 雙方重新展開談判，着眼於達成長期協議。
exercises.upgrade: with a view to reaching · 着眼於達成

options.explanation: 正式談判語境常用，表示當前行動着眼於未來結果。
應為 so as to reach。

exercises.original: The organisation revised its policy in order to make future applications simpler.
exercises.zh: 機構修訂政策，着眼於令日後申請程序更簡單。
exercises.upgrade: with a view to making · 以令……為目的

options.explanation: revised policy + future applications 表示現在改動是着眼於未來改善。
應為 so as to make。
to 是介詞，後面應接 making。
不是標準目的表達。 --- End of teaching material

falseSynonyms.zh: 因為不等於目的 because 表示原因；in order to 表示目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She left early because she was tired. She left early in order to catch the train.

falseSynonyms.zh: 所以／因此不一定等於 in order to so 常表示結果；in order to 表示做某事的目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It was raining, so we stayed inside. We stayed inside in order to keep dry.

falseSynonyms.zh: 因此不等於目的 therefore 表示邏輯結果或結論，不表示目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The road was closed; therefore, we took another route.

falseSynonyms.zh: 為了不等於所有 in order to 結構 for 可以表示用途或受益者，但後面通常接名詞，不直接接動詞原形來表示目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This room is for meetings. We booked the room to hold a meeting.

falseSynonyms.zh: 以便；為了讓…… so that 也表示目的，但後面接完整子句，而不是直接接動詞原形。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She spoke slowly so that everyone could understand. She spoke slowly in order to help everyone understand.

falseSynonyms.zh: 以防不等於為了 in case 表示為可能發生的情況作準備，不等於一般目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Take an umbrella in case it rains. Take an umbrella to stay dry.

falseSynonyms.word: In order to / in order for
falseSynonyms.zh: 主語結構不同 in order to 通常由主句主語執行後面的動作；若後面動作由另一主語執行，常用 in order for + noun + to-infinitive。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She left early in order to catch the train. She left early in order for her colleague to use the car.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞和副詞不同 purpose 是名詞「目的」；purposely 是副詞「故意地」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The purpose of the meeting was to solve the problem. He purposely arrived late.
